An '''auscultator''' was a device used by medical personnel for auscultation&mdash;listening to internal bodily sounds, such as those of the [[Heart/Legends|heart]]. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Kornell Divini]] used one on [[Memah Roothes]] to listen to her heart during a routine medical examination aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].
